page.text:
Integration aggregates local values over an interval. Riemann's
construction compares a bounded function with upper and lower step
functions determined by finite partitions. Integrability means that the
uncertainty between these approximations can be made arbitrarily small;
it is not built into the notation $\int_a^b f$.
